Technology with a direction

02

FOR YOURSELF

Small steps.
New possibilities.

Personal growth starts with a goal that matters to you, a manageable next step, and the mindset to keep going.

Let’s talk about your goals ↗
Clarity before momentum

Make space to reflect on what you want to change. Turn a broad ambition into a clear direction and a first step that fits your life.

Habits you can build on

Break a meaningful goal into repeatable actions. Use simple planning and reflection tools to notice progress, learn from setbacks, and adjust along the way.

A practical, positive mindset

Recognize your strengths and the choices within your control. A positive attitude makes room for challenges while helping you see a way forward.

BUSINESS WORKFLOW IMPROVEMENT

Less repetitive work.
More time for what matters.

Practical support for business owners and managers who see repetitive work taking up their team's time. We start with how the work gets done today and look for changes that can make a measurable difference.

01

Map the work as it happens.

Together, we map your core workflows and identify manual, repetitive tasks that consume time, slow things down, or lead to errors.

WORKFLOW MAPPING & REPEATING TASKS
02

Build a 30-day action plan.

We assess where AI or automation can help and where another approach makes more sense. Then we build a practical action plan for the next 30 days, with priorities and clear measures of progress.

PRACTICAL CHANGES, CLEAR PRIORITIES
03

Review what actually changed.

A follow-up meeting after one month checks what changed in practice: less manual work, shorter handling times, fewer errors, or more time for important work. We review the results and decide what to adjust next.

FOLLOW-UP AFTER ONE MONTH

DEKEL ASAFENGINEER / LEADER / BUILDER

THE PERSON BEHIND TOVLI

Systems thinking.
Human purpose.

I’m Dekel Asaf. I bring an engineering lens to business challenges, and a human lens to the technology we build.

My background spans engineering leadership at CyberArk, eToro, and Transmit Security. Today, I’m a technical partner at Cognitum and co-founder & CTO at Mall Shop Link.

I build open-source tools, write about leadership, co-host Hebrew AI podcasts, and volunteer on technology with social impact. Tovli Technologies brings that same commitment to helping businesses and people reach meaningful goals.
